purpose.zh: 哥萨克蹲，练内收肌与侧向深蹲
purpose.en: Train a controlled lateral squat and inner-thigh mobility with alternating loaded legs.

text.zh: 宽站蹲向一侧，另一腿伸直，脚尖朝上
text.en: Squat towards one side from a wide stance, keeping the other leg straight with its toes up

text.zh: 先向右腿承重下蹲，承重脚跟踩稳
text.en: Squat onto the right leg first and keep the loaded heel planted.

text.zh: 胸口保持抬起，膝盖沿承重脚脚尖方向移动
text.en: Keep the chest lifted and let the loaded knee follow its toes.

text.zh: 缓慢回到中间站高，再换左侧，不弹振硬压
text.en: Return slowly to the tall centre position before changing to the left, without bouncing.

commonErrors.zh: 承重膝盖内扣、脚跟离地或突然滑向一侧
commonErrors.en: Letting the loaded knee collapse inwards, lifting its heel or sliding suddenly sideways.

commonErrors.zh: 非承重腿弯曲、脚尖未抬起，或塌腰追求更深幅度
commonErrors.en: Bending the unloaded leg, failing to raise its toes or rounding the back to force more depth.

items.zh: 膝与踝：承重侧脚跟保持着地；伸直侧脚尖抬起，以脚跟为支点。
items.en: Knees and ankles: keep the loaded heel planted and let the straight-leg foot pivot on its heel with the toes up.

items.zh: 髋与大腿内侧：选能控制的侧蹲深度，避免向底部猛压。
items.en: Hips and inner thighs: choose a lateral squat depth you can control without forcing the bottom position.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制单侧深蹲、侧向负重或髋膝踝活动时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if single-sided deep squatting, sideways loading or hip, knee or ankle movement has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: One lateral squat and return led by one loaded leg counts as one rep. The 8-second clip demonstrates one right-loaded then one left-loaded rep. Preserve FlareLab prescription: default reps=5 is per side (five full loops give five reps on each side), not five total alternating reps. Switch loaded leg at 4 seconds.
definition.movementSides: First squat loads the right leg and straightens/raises toes of the left; after 4 seconds the left leg loads and right leg straightens. Highlight remains both.
editorialNotes: 旧FlareLab明确3组×每侧5–6次，沿catalog默认每侧5次，不擅改为总5次。8秒片右/左各1次，默认每组需5个完整循环。
原spec没有modelProfile；r2明确新模型。保留伸直腿reach=177.5、滚脚heel pivot和原求解器；不在迁移时静默校正接触。
原stillAt=0为直立，batch peak改用1.9667秒右侧底部；原source stillAt/keyFrames保留。n-squat-shift是旧目录明确替代，也为减少伸膝抬趾/深侧蹲要求的降阶候选；独立负重进阶ID未核定。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b002.json真实源时间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog。rhythm只描述动画，不使用旧reps或holdSeconds来覆盖处方。
具体双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均为待审草稿；协同包含稳定/次要拉伸角色，不是额外高亮或肌电激活结论。
关系均为本仓库真实ID候选，不等于已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系缺口见逐动作说明。
通用医学筛查证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md的AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌，编辑/医学审核均保持pending。

switchPoint.semantics: First squat loads the right leg and straightens/raises toes of the left; after 4 seconds the left leg loads and right leg straightens. Highlight remains both. One lateral squat and return led by one loaded leg counts as one rep. The 8-second clip demonstrates one right-loaded then one left-loaded rep. Preserve FlareLab prescription: default reps=5 is per side (five full loops give five reps on each side), not five total alternating reps. Switch loaded leg at 4 seconds.
